# discount_split

Spreads a discount over the lines of a bill in proportion to their amounts, a line at a time through the rule, so that the shares come to the discount

- File: `discount_split.kn` (module discount_split v1, sha256:0fd204b8bd5c18fb)

## Functions

A function's effect puts it in one of three parts. A total function answers every input in the ranges it declares. A function checked when it runs has places the checks could not show: the generated code checks the value there, and when it is outside, fails with the kind of the place (`rule` and so on). ### Total

#### `split`

Total: it answers every input in the ranges it declares. Its head writes `total`, and kaname holds it to that.

The running totals go to the rule; the last line carries what the rounding leaves.

```kn
fn split(lines: list[Line] count >=1 <=10, discount: money[USDc] range >=0USDc <=10_000_000USDc) -> list[Share] total
  description "The running totals go to the rule; the last line carries what the rounding leaves"
  map(running_totals(lines, l => l.amount), r =>
    Share { label: r.item.label, share: discount_share(discount: discount, before: r.before, upto: r.upto, total: r.total).share })
```
